actual_literal_use_paragraphs:
Assume the Axiom of Choice ([[def-axiom-of-choice]]). The definition
[[def-equivariant-constructible-derived-category-for-complex-algebraic-varieties]]
gives a locally small triangulated category $D^b_{G,c}(X;k)$ with conservative
restriction to $X$ and the stated ordinary shift, and its morphism groups are
computed by the coinduced simplicial injectives of
[[lem-locally-split-cech-nerves-give-derived-cartesian-sheaf-descent]]. Locally
split free-action descent identifies its finite general linear Stiefel
resolution with the full bounded resolution-triple subcategory on $X_N$, and
the bounded Hom and image comparisons, the degree-zero ring comparison and
retract closure of
[[lem-product-general-linear-stiefel-approximations-stabilize-bounded-constructible-hom]]
hold for it. The category is idempotent complete. No derived full faithfulness
of restriction to $X$ is asserted.

[F3] The Stiefel resolution
([[lem-product-general-linear-stiefel-approximations-stabilize-bounded-constructible-hom]]):
for $N_i\ge n_i+1$, the finite frame resolutions $U_N\to B_N$, the associated
varieties $X_N=(U_N\times X)/G$ and the functor $Q_N$ identify the equivariant
Hom groups with ordinary Hom groups on $X_N$ in the range
$m\le b+r_N-a$, the functor is fully faithful on intervals of width at most
$r_N$, and its image is the full resolution-triple subcategory of
$D_c^{[b,a]}(X_N;k)$ with retract closure and extension closure under the
strict bound.

actual_literal_use_paragraphs:
[F1] The finite Stiefel comparison
([[lem-product-general-linear-stiefel-approximations-stabilize-bounded-constructible-hom]],
[[lem-general-linear-stiefel-frame-spaces-have-the-cohomology-gap]]): for
$A\le a$ and $B\ge b$ and $m\le b+r_N-a$ there is a natural isomorphism
$\operatorname{Hom}_G(A,B[m])\cong\operatorname{Hom}_{X_N}(Q_N(A),Q_N(B)[m])$;
the frame spaces have the cohomology gap $H^j(U_N;k)=0$ for
$1\le j\le r_N$, and for a fixed bounded amplitude one can choose $N$ with
$r_N$ larger than any prescribed finite bound.

actual_literal_use_paragraphs:
**Given:** The Axiom of Choice; the coefficient field $k$ of characteristic
zero; the group $G=\mathbb C^\times$ acting trivially on the point; the finite
Stiefel approximations of
[[lem-product-general-linear-stiefel-approximations-stabilize-bounded-constructible-hom]]
with $U_N=\mathbb C^N\setminus\{0\}$, $B_N=\operatorname{Gr}_1(\mathbb C^N)$,
$r_N=2(N-1)$ and $X_N=U_N/\mathbb C^\times$.

[F1] For the trivial action on the point, $U_N=\operatorname{Inj}(\mathbb C,\mathbb C^N)$ is the full-rank frame space and $X_N=(U_N\times\operatorname{pt})/G=U_N/\mathbb C^\times$ is the associated quotient; the map $U_N\to X_N$ is the $\mathbb C^\times$-bundle of the construction, and $Q_N(k)$ is the constant sheaf $k_{X_N}$ ([[lem-product-general-linear-stiefel-approximations-stabilize-bounded-constructible-hom]], [[def-equivariant-constructible-derived-category-for-complex-algebraic-varieties]]).

[F2] The bounded Hom comparison gives $\operatorname{Ext}_G^m(k,k)\cong\operatorname{Hom}_{X_N}(Q_N(k),Q_N(k)[m])$ whenever $m\le r_N$ ([[lem-product-general-linear-stiefel-approximations-stabilize-bounded-constructible-hom]]).

actual_literal_use_paragraphs: [F2] In [[def-equivariant-borel-moore-homology-and-correspondence-convolution]], $H_j^{\mathrm{BM},G}(X;k)=\operatorname{Hom}_{D^b_{G,c}(X;k)}(k_X,\omega_X^G[-j])$, and ordinary Borel–Moore homology is $H_j^{\mathrm{BM}}(X;k)=\operatorname{Hom}(k_X,\omega_X[-j])$, which for smooth complex $X$ of pure dimension $d$, where $\omega_X=k_X[2d]$, equals $H^{2d-j}(X;k)$. For the trivial group the nerve of [[def-equivariant-constructible-derived-category-for-complex-algebraic-varieties]] is constant at $X$, the Cartesian condition is vacuous, and the category is the ordinary bounded constructible category, the identity Borel model being the one with $r_N=\infty$ and $Q_N=\mathrm{id}$ in [[lem-product-general-linear-stiefel-approximations-stabilize-bounded-constructible-hom]].

[F5] The finite Stiefel resolution
([[lem-product-general-linear-stiefel-approximations-stabilize-bounded-constructible-hom]]):
for integers $N_i\ge n_i+1$ the frame spaces $U_N\to B_N$, the associated
varieties $X_N=(U_N\times X)/G$ and the functor $Q_N$ satisfy the Hom comparison
$\operatorname{Hom}_G(A,B[m])\cong\operatorname{Hom}_{X_N}(Q_N(A),Q_N(B)[m])$
for $m\le b+r_N-a$ with $r_N=2\min_i(N_i-n_i)$, full faithfulness and the image
description on intervals of width at most $r_N$, and the trivial-group clause
$r_N=\infty$, $Q_N=\mathrm{id}$.
